messages:
Ana P (partnerships): Quick sync reminder — vendor roadmap touch tomorrow 9:00am PT. Goals: final SKU gating list for the marketplace, embargo windows per vendor, and SI onboarding readiness. Drop any blockers here so we can prep the agenda.
Sam R (eng-infra): Heads up — eng side: H100/H200 kernels ✅, MI300 perf tuning done ✅. Still waiting on final B200 firmware from vendor (told us EOD). If that slips we can't certify the B200 stack.
Jess M (product): Product ask: we need a confirmed canary rollout date for the marketplace offering. Prefer 2025-09-15 for internal planning. Is that still realistic?
Marco D (platform): Platform needs: AMI/image tags and the test harness artifact for MI300 + Gaudi. Once I have the image tar + manifest I can push to staging and run the end-to-end smoke. Can vendor provide image checksum.
Liwei C (marketing): Marketing: need embargo windows + PR contact per vendor (NVIDIA / Tenstella/Gaudi partner). Also need one-paragraph partner blurb for each SKU by EOD tomorrow so we can draft comms.
Sam R (eng-infra): @Ana P -- quick SKU state snippet:
```
H100: drivers + infra ready
H200: compatibility verified
B200: firmware pending vendor sign-off
MI300: perf tuning complete
Gaudi: test harness outstanding (SI to deliver)
```
Ana P (partnerships): Thanks Sam — I'm adding that to the agenda. Can retailers/SI leads @Marco and @Jess confirm who is DRI for Gaudi test harness delivery?
Marco D (platform): DRI for Gaudi harness: Marco D (platform) owns integration but we need SI artifact from CloudWave by COB Friday. I'll send the upload link.
Jess M (product): DRI for SI onboarding + docs: Jess M (product). Will own the playbook and acceptance criteria.
Liwei C (marketing): Confirmed contacts: NVIDIA press ops — nvidia-press@example.com; Tenstella (Gaudi) — tenstella-comm@example.com. Will follow up with draft embargo language.
Sam R (eng-infra): Risk: if B200 firmware slips past Friday, our marketplace SKU gating will mark B200 as "beta" (no GA). We should set fallback: H100/H200 + MI300 GA, B200 beta.
Ana P (partnerships): Action items (I'll compile into a DRI table):
- Sam: chase B200 firmware, confirm checksum (due: EOD today)
- Marco: provide staging upload link + timeline for Gaudi artifacts (due: COB Fri)
- Jess: finalize canary rollout date & playbook (due: EOD Thu)
- Liwei: draft embargo copy + vendor contacts (due: EOD Thu)
- Ana: send consolidated agenda + DRI table before 8am PT tomorrow.
QA-bot: Reminder set: Meeting scheduled — 2025-08-21 09:00:00 PT (auto-reminder 30m before).
Sam R (eng-infra): quick note — adding a small `compat_flags` toggle to the marketplace config so we can gate B200 behind a feature flag if needed. Will stub PR tonight. :thumbsup:
Liwei C (marketing): If we end up with a split GA/beta messaging, let's plan a two-phased comms: initial GA for H100/MI300; beta note for B200 with ETA window.
Ana P (partnerships): Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll collate and share the agenda + DRI table. See you tomorrow 9am PT. :raised_hands:
